content.text:
I fixed the parser so `checked` and `pressed` accept `'mixed'` again. I haven't built or run anything, so the round trip is untested.

The change is in `getByRoleParts` in `packages/isomorphic/locatorParser.ts`. The `checked` and `pressed` options now go through a new `isBooleanOrMixed` check, which accepts a boolean or the string `'mixed'`. Every other role option (`disabled`, `expanded`, `selected` and so on) still accepts only booleans.

I didn't check how the Java and C# forms of the value are parsed. The fix assumes the parser returns the plain string `'mixed'` for all four languages, as it does for JavaScript and Python. If Java or C# produce a different value, those two would still fail.
